term: normal-first all-witness selection with originating-context repair
definition: Selected origin A selects each normal u satisfying A. A repair u is selected only if no normal witness of A exists, u=origin and A holds at that repair. SelectedConditional universally evaluates its consequent on those selected states. The selector has success and no repairs for normal-witness antecedents; it is not claimed centered, nearest-world, serial, or a full Lewis/Stalnaker semantics. NormalConditional evaluates all normal A witnesses and is not material implication at the origin.
note: Analyst bounded comparison for #1085; attribution deferred. The old no-latent-source-intervention boundary is retained. No actual counterpossible truth, metaphysical possibility, causation, grounding or root discharge is asserted. See docs/notes/counterpossible-conservativity.md.
